newsitem.title: USA: SIBIA, Eli Lilly extend pact.
newsitem.headline: SIBIA, Eli Lilly extend pact.

text.p: SIBIA Neurosciences Inc and Eli Lilly & Co agreed to extend their collaborative research in the area of neuronal voltage-gated calcium channels, the companies said on Wednesday.

Under the pact, Lilly will provide research funding for the identification and characterization of a new voltage-gated calcium-channel subtype for use in the discovery of drugs for central nervous system disorders.
This agreement is the second extension of the original collaborative agreement between SIBIA and Lilly, struck in May 1992. It was first extended in May 1995.
Voltage-gated calcium channels are one of the pathways through which calcium ions enter nerve cells. While calcium is vital to normal functioning of nerve cells, excess calcium can kill them.

Controlling the level of calcium within neurons offers a potential therapeutic approach to many nervous system disorders, including stroke, epilepsy, pain, Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease and other dementias.

During the new agreement, SIBIA will work exclusively with Lilly on the newly targeted voltage-gated calcium channels subtype, and it will retain the right to pursue this target in its own drug-discovery efforts, subject to a right of first negotiation granted to Lilly.
SIBIA will also receive milestone payments and royalties on sales of products based on this subtype.
